title: Western Europe faces unprecedented drought, threatening human activity and ecosystems
subhead: The western part of the continent has seen soil moisture levels drop far below those of July 2022, 'the last summer marked by a severe drought across Western Europe,' according to the Copernicus Climate Change Service.

Iran's increasing repression of civil society
subhead: The authorities are intensifying their crackdown on spaces of freedom. Photojournalist Yalda Moaiery has been sentenced to 15 years in prison, executions are on the rise, artists are being summoned by the authorities and cafés are being shut down.

title: Demi Vollering's Tour de France victory marks the triumph of 'the best cyclist in the world' and a team dedicated to the pursuit of the yellow jersey
subhead: The Dutch rider claimed the second Tour de France title of her career on Sunday. In a race that remained undecided until the very end, she relied on the unwavering support of her FDJ United-Suez teammates.

title: Afghan refugee in southern France charged with terrorism after clandestine stay with Taliban
subhead: A 28-year-old man holding refugee status in France is suspected of traveling to Afghanistan for military training and returning with jihadist intentions. Arrested in Lourdes, he was placed in pretrial detention on July 3.

title: 'Why shouldn't I have the right to do what Angelina Jolie did?': Inside a breast surgery clinic in Paris
subhead: 'My Breasts and Me' (1/5). For aesthetic, social, medical or political reasons, some women want smaller breasts, or none at all – a growing number of requests that simply did not exist some 15 years ago. Le Monde spent several weeks at the Paris Breast Center Restitute to understand this changing trend.
